<!-- Source page: HeadsetControl -->

HeadsetControl is a CLI that helps you manage various makes and models of wireless headsets. See currently supported headsets here: <https://github.com/Sapd/HeadsetControl#supported-devices>

It can also be used in conjunction with other GUI elements such as tray icons: <https://github.com/Sapd/HeadsetControl#gui-applications>

## Installation

The project's README has installation instructions for the standalone CLI for NixOS: <https://github.com/Sapd/HeadsetControl#nixos>
